content.user_title: Manage Google Sheets with the gws CLI
content.value_statement: Google Sheets API commands can be difficult to discover and structure correctly. This skill guides Claude and Codex through supported gws resources, methods, and flags.
actual_capabilities: Discover Google Sheets resources and methods through gws help commands.
Inspect required parameters, types, and defaults with gws schema.
Create spreadsheets through the Sheets API.
Retrieve spreadsheets by identifier or data filter.
Apply validated spreadsheet updates with batchUpdate.
Direct users to helper skills for reading values and appending rows.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and its generated shared authentication skill.
Requires valid Google Workspace credentials and permission for each target spreadsheet.
Provides command guidance but does not document every method parameter.
Spreadsheet changes remain subject to Google Sheets API validation and quotas.

use_cases.title: Inspect spreadsheet data
use_cases.description: Find the correct read command and parameters for a known spreadsheet.
use_cases.target_user: Analysts who need spreadsheet values for review

use_cases.title: Create operational spreadsheets
use_cases.description: Build a new spreadsheet and verify the returned spreadsheet details.

use_cases.title: Automate structured updates
use_cases.description: Inspect batchUpdate requirements before applying multiple validated changes.

prompt_templates.title: List available Sheets commands
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the gws command that lists Google Sheets resources and methods. Explain what I should inspect next.

prompt_templates.title: Read a spreadsheet range
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me read {range} from spreadsheet {spreadsheet_id}. Inspect the method schema before preparing the command.
prompt_templates.scenario: Retrieve values from a known range

prompt_templates.title: Create a spreadsheet
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a gws command to create a spreadsheet named {title}. Verify required parameters and explain the expected result.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a new Google Sheets file

prompt_templates.title: Plan a batch update
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the batchUpdate schema for spreadsheet {spreadsheet_id}. Prepare validated changes for {update_goal} and identify any atomic failure risks.

output_examples.input: Find how to inspect the parameters for creating a spreadsheet.
output_examples.output: Inspect the create method schema first. Review its required parameters, accepted types, and defaults before preparing the create request.

output_examples.input: Explain what happens when one request in a batch update is invalid.
output_examples.output: The entire batch update fails, and no requested changes are applied. Validate every request before submission.

output_examples.input: How can I retrieve only selected spreadsheet data?
output_examples.output: Use a field mask, disable unnecessary grid data, or select subsets with data filters. Inspect the relevant method schema before execution.

best_practices: Inspect each method schema before building params or request bodies.
Use the narrowest spreadsheet range, field mask, or data filter needed.
Confirm the spreadsheet identifier and update intent before write operations.
anti_patterns: Do not guess parameter names or request shapes without schema inspection.
Do not request complete grid data when selected fields are sufficient.
Do not submit batch updates before validating every included request.

faq.question: What must be installed before using this skill?
faq.answer: Install the gws CLI and generate the shared skill that provides authentication, global flags, and security rules.

faq.question: Can this skill read spreadsheet values?
faq.answer: Yes. It directs value retrieval to the dedicated read helper and documents relevant Sheets resources.

faq.question: Can this skill append rows?
faq.answer: Yes. It directs row appends to the dedicated append helper skill.

faq.question: Does this skill manage authentication?
faq.answer: No. Authentication guidance comes from the generated shared gws skill and your Google Workspace credentials.

faq.question: Are batch updates applied partially?
faq.answer: No. If any request is invalid, the entire batch fails and no changes are applied.

faq.question: How do I discover required method parameters?
faq.answer: Inspect the method with gws schema, then use its output to build params and request data.
